So $3 \mid (x_1^2 + x_1x_2 + x_2^2)$. Since $x_1^2 + x_1x_2 + x_2^2 \equiv (x_1 - x_2)^2 \pmod{3}$, we get $3 \mid (x_1 - x_2)$, so $x_1 \equiv x_2 \pmod{3}$, and then $x_3 = -(x_1+x_2) \equiv x_1 \pmod{3}$.
